-84.27250,34.05420.name: Hope Fertility
-84.27250,34.05420.desc: A fertility clinic reporting to the CDC's National ART Surveillance System. Medical director: Obehi A. Asemota, MD. A fertility clinic is where human embryos are made, selected and stored, and where assisted reproduction happens, like IVF, ICSI, egg and sperm donation, freezing embryos and eggs for later. Reporting is required of every US clinic performing assisted reproduction, under the Fertility Clinic Success Rate and Certification Act, so this is close to a complete register rather than a list of members. What it records is cycles started, which is not the same as children born.

OpenStreetMap holds what somebody chose to map, so a country with few points here may be thinly mapped rather than thinly served. 7.64396,46.69047.name: Spiez Laboratory
7.64396,46.69047.state: LABOR SPIEZ, Austrasse, 3700 Spiez, Switzerland, Switzerland
7.64396,46.69047.company: Federal Office for Civil Protection, Federal Department of Defence, Civil Protection and Sports
7.64396,46.69047.desc: A BSL4 laboratory, operational. Run by Federal Office for Civil Protection, Federal Department of Defence, Civil Protection and Sports. It is categorised as a defense laboratory, working on human health. Personnel work in full-body positive-pressure suits with their own air supply. Containment space: 132 SqM. Operational or announced: 2014. There is no international register of laboratories at this containment level and no obligation to declare one, so this record comes from a research project rather than a regulator. What that project could not find out is absent here too.

-91.60600,41.75900.name: Integrated DNA Technologies (Danaher)
-91.60600,41.75900.desc: IDT supplies the oligonucleotides and CRISPR reagents that laboratory work runs on, now inside Danaher, a conglomerate that has bought much of the life-science supply chain. A handful of holding companies control the consumables every laboratory needs daily, so a purchasing decision made for margin at group level propagates into thousands of experiments that have no alternative supplier.

-77.01800,38.90070.name: Covington & Burling — food and drug regulatory
-77.01800,38.90070.desc: One of the principal firms advising food and biotechnology companies on US regulation, with lawyers moving between the firm and senior regulatory posts. The movement is documented in public appointment records, which makes it checkable rather than assumed.

-77.02500,38.89700.name: SEC EDGAR — full-text search
-77.02500,38.89700.state: Washington DC — SEC, 100 F St NE
-77.02500,38.89700.desc: Every filing by every US-listed company, searchable in full text. Companies must disclose material risks and segment finances accurately or commit an offence, which makes this the most reliable public account of what firms on this map actually earn and fear.

135.19000,34.69000.name: GM oilseed rape naturalised around import ports
135.19000,34.69000.type: Canola, feral populations at import points
135.19000,34.69000.size: Roadsides between ports and crushing plants
135.19000,34.69000.desc: Engineered oilseed rape found naturalised around Japanese ports and along the roads inland from them, spilled from imported grain in transit. Japan grows none of it. The plants arrived as cargo.

11.59000,48.16000.name: Munich Re — agricultural and biotechnology risk
11.59000,48.16000.desc: Reinsurers price agricultural and liability risk, including for engineered crops and for the contamination claims that follow a spread event. An insurer deciding a risk is uninsurable stops a technology more completely than a regulator refusing a licence, and it does so commercially, without a hearing, and without publishing the reasoning.

113.99600,22.59800.name: Southern University of Science and Technology — He Jiankui affair
113.99600,22.59800.desc: Where He Jiankui was employed when he edited the embryos that became the first gene-edited babies, announced in 2018. He was jailed, the university disowned the work, and China wrote germline editing into its criminal law. It is on this map because it is the only place where a human germline edit is known to have been carried to birth, and because the response to it set the rules everywhere else.
